contentEn:
Our client is a leading Austrian multinational company specializing in innovative plastic packaging solutions, with an extensive manufacturing network across multiple countries.

The company develops and manufactures high-quality plastic packaging, bottles, caps, and injection-moulded products for major international customers.

Position Overview

The Japanese Business Development Manager will be responsible for developing the Japanese market, identifying new business opportunities, acquiring new customers, expanding existing accounts, and developing new business segments within the rigid plastic packaging and injection molding industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead marketing and business development activities for the Japanese market.
  • Acquire new customers and expand business opportunities with existing accounts.
  • Develop new customer segments in the injection molding business.
  • Follow up on sales projects and identify customer requirements.
  • Provide solutions supporting customers' logistics and production activities.
  • Build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.
  • Conduct market, customer and competitor analysis.
  • Participate in tenders and manage quotations, negotiations and project follow-up.
  • Negotiate pricing, contracts and commercial terms.
  • Prepare business plans and product/article calculations.
  • Support Country Management in business-related decision-making.
  • Coordinate customer requirements across finance, operations, quality, technical and other commercial functions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related field.
  • Relevant business development/acquisition and marketing experience in the rigid plastic packaging industry in Japan.
  • Candidates with less than five years of experience may also be considered if their experience is directly relevant to the required industry.
  • Excellent Excel, PowerPoint and Word skills.
  • Strong numerical and analytical capabilities.
  • Good English communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Japanese talent who can be based in China, Thailand, Vietnam, the Philippines or Singapore.

Compensation & Benefits

USD 4,000–5,000/month.

A higher package may be negotiable for strong candidates currently based in Vietnam, depending on experience and suitability.

Benefits include: housing allowance, work permit and employment-documentation support, performance-based remuneration, and professional development opportunities.

APPLICATION & CONTACT

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV to:

MIRAI VIET NAM HR CONSULTING
📧 Email: [Mirai recruitment email]
📞 Phone/Zalo: (+84) 933 643 654
📍 Office: 4th Floor, IMC Tower, 62 Tran Quang Khai Street, Tan Dinh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted directly by Mirai Viet Nam HR Consulting.

会社概要

Mirai Viet Nam HR Consultingのクライアント企業は、革新的なプラスチック包装ソリューションを提供するオーストリア系大手グローバル企業です。

世界各国に製造拠点を展開し、高品質なプラスチック包装、ボトル、キャップ、射出成形製品などを開発・製造しています。

ポジション概要

日本市場における事業開発を担当し、新規顧客の開拓、既存顧客との取引拡大、新規事業分野の開拓などを推進していただきます。

主な業務内容

  • 日本市場におけるマーケティングおよび事業開発
  • 新規顧客の開拓および既存顧客への深耕営業
  • 射出成形事業における新規顧客・市場セグメントの開拓
  • 営業案件のフォローおよび顧客ニーズの把握
  • 顧客の物流・生産活動に対するソリューション提案
  • 顧客との長期的な関係構築
  • 顧客・市場動向・競合他社の分析
  • 入札、見積、商談、プロジェクト進捗のフォロー
  • 価格、契約、取引条件等の交渉
  • 事業計画および製品関連の計算・分析
  • カントリーマネジメントの事業意思決定支援
  • 財務、オペレーション、品質、技術部門等との社内調整

応募資格

  • マーケティング、経営学または関連分野の学士号以上
  • 日本市場における硬質プラスチック包装業界での新規顧客開拓・マーケティング経験
  • 経験年数が5年未満の場合でも、業界・職務経験が募集要件と直接関連している方は選考対象となります。
  • Excel、PowerPoint、Word等のPCスキル
  • 数値分析・データ分析能力
  • 英語でのコミュニケーション能力
  • 高いコミュニケーション力、プレゼンテーション力、交渉力
  • 中国、タイ、ベトナム、フィリピン、シンガポール等を拠点として勤務可能な日本人材

給与・待遇

月額4,000～5,000米ドル

現在ベトナム在住の経験豊富な候補者については、経験・適性に応じて上記を超える給与条件も相談可能です。
